alt: Top portion of a small dark-grey brushed-metal device with two pill-shaped LED lights and one large light-grey rectangular button with a prominent red dot in the center
story: Nothing (the phone maker behind Phone 2 and Phone 3) teased its first 'AI-native product' on November 10, 2026: a handleless brushed-metal rectangle with two pill-shaped LEDs and one large rectangular button with a red dot, described as a screenless 'productivity tool' — launching December 2026 — with pundits already comparing it to a 1970s dictaphone.
why_funny: A company famous for making phones beautiful with transparent backs and glowing LED strips unveils its vision for the AI future: an object that looks exactly like an old tape recorder.
